data.name: Bhangarh: The Untold Story
data.detailed_description:
Bhangarh: The Untold Story

Bhangarh: The Untold Story is a psychological survival horror experience set in the cursed ruins of India’s most haunted fort.


The Real Bhangarh

Bhangarh Fort is a real location in Rajasthan - often called the most haunted place in Asia. Built in the 16th century by Raja Madho Singh, the fort now stands abandoned, shrouded in mystery.
According to legend, a sorcerer named Singhiya cursed the land after being rejected by Princess Ratnavati, dooming Bhangarh to eternal ruin. Locals believe that anyone who stays past sunset never returns, and the Archaeological Survey of India even forbids entry after dark.


About the Game

Story:

Set in 1985, an investigator and his wife, Vanya, visit the abandoned ruins of Bhangarh Fort after hearing its chilling legends. Disturbed by a dark presence within the fort, they flee before nightfall. Unable to forget what she witnessed, Vanya spends the night researching the mystery of Bhangarh, the disappearance of an entire Village, and why no one dares enter the fort after sunset. By morning, she has vanished without a trace.

With his only lead pointing back to Bhangarh, the investigator returns to Bhangarh in search of her. What begins as a rescue mission soon becomes a desperate fight for survival as he relives the final days of Queen Ratnavati and uncovers an ancient darkness buried beneath the ruins. Some mysteries were never meant to be uncovered.

Visuals and Atmosphere :

The game features realistic environments, eerie lighting, and haunting sound design crafted to capture the chilling essence of an abandoned, cursed fortress. Every corner of Bhangarh is built to create a sense of isolation, unease, and the constant feeling of being watched. Soundscapes, environmental details, and dynamic tension work together to immerse players in a truly unsettling journey through one of India’s darkest legends.

Features :

A deeply atmospheric, story-driven horror experience inspired by real Indian folklore and the legends of Bhangarh.

  • Cinematic cutscenes seamlessly integrated into gameplay to enhance immersion and strengthen the narrative.

  • Exploration-focused gameplay where players uncover mysteries through environmental storytelling, letters, relics, and supernatural encounters.

  • A tense psychological horror atmosphere designed to create fear, uncertainty, and growing tension as the story progresses.

Gameplay :

Players take on the role of a journalist exploring the ruins of Bhangarh in search of answers. The gameplay focuses on exploration, survival, and uncovering the supernatural mysteries hidden within the fortress. You will investigate abandoned structures, discover symbolic markings, interact with ancient relics, and navigate terrifying encounters as the truth slowly reveals itself. With limited resources and an environment designed to distort perception, every moment becomes a struggle to survive the horrors that awaken with your arrival.

data.short_description: Inspired by the legends surrounding Asia's infamous Bhangarh Fort, set in 1985. When his wife, Vanya, mysteriously goes missing, an investigator follows a lead to the abandoned ruins of Bhangarh Fort. What begins as a rescue mission soon becomes a fight to survive the untold story of Bhangarh.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains psychological horror and intense atmospheric tension. Players may encounter realistic violence, disturbing sounds, paranormal events, and areas designed to create fear or discomfort. Some scenes may be emotionally intense or unsettling for sensitive players. This content may not be suitable for all ages.
